unbounded_or_unproved: String/JSON table acceptance has no application-wide byte/node/depth bound; physical DB/runtime limits are not claimed infinite, just unspecified/variable by backend and unsuitable as this product bound.
Ordinary result/error/context and unchecked JSON extras are not globally covered by wire/archive caps.
SQLAlchemy RowMapping constructor/type does not attest cursor/query provenance or hidden-data/index size.
Positive lower bounds on version/fence do not establish application-wide upper bit-length; actual DB Integer ranges are backend restrictions, not portable Python/forged-row bounds.
SQLAlchemy DBAPI acquisition and JSON deserialization happen before a post-read meter; its own bounded scratch does not prove total query/decode memory bounded.
